About this item

  • SMART TOUCHSCREEN CASE: Manage your wireless earbuds directly from the built-in touchscreen case. Adjust volume, switch tracks, answer calls, locate the ear buds, select listening modes, and use the camera remote without opening an app or reaching for your phone.
  • HI-FI SOUND & 5 EQ MODES: Powerful 13mm drivers deliver deep bass, clear vocals, and crisp highs. Choose from Bass, Rock, Pop, Classical, and Jazz EQ modes to match different music styles and listening preferences.
  • ANC NOISE CANCELLING & ENC CLEAR CALLS: ANC helps reduce distracting background noise for more focused listening, while ENC improves voice clarity during calls. Switch listening modes directly from the touchscreen case for commuting, work, and travel.
  • BLUETOOTH 5.4 CONNECTION: Enjoy fast pairing, low-latency audio, and a stable connection up to 33 ft. These Bluetooth headphones work with iPhone, Android phones, tablets, and other Bluetooth-enabled devices.
  • 48H PLAYTIME & COMFORTABLE FIT: Get up to 6 hours of listening on one charge and up to 48 hours with the charging case. The lightweight ergonomic in-ear design provides a secure, comfortable fit for workouts, commuting, work, and daily use.

    About this Item

    • SMART TOUCHSCREEN CASE: Manage your wireless earbuds directly from the built-in touchscreen case. Adjust volume, switch tracks, answer calls, locate the ear buds, select listening modes, and use the camera remote without opening an app or reaching for your phone.
    • HI-FI SOUND & 5 EQ MODES: Powerful 13mm drivers deliver deep bass, clear vocals, and crisp highs. Choose from Bass, Rock, Pop, Classical, and Jazz EQ modes to match different music styles and listening preferences.
    • ANC NOISE CANCELLING & ENC CLEAR CALLS: ANC helps reduce distracting background noise for more focused listening, while ENC improves voice clarity during calls. Switch listening modes directly from the touchscreen case for commuting, work, and travel.
    • BLUETOOTH 5.4 CONNECTION: Enjoy fast pairing, low-latency audio, and a stable connection up to 33 ft. These Bluetooth headphones work with iPhone, Android phones, tablets, and other Bluetooth-enabled devices.
    • 48H PLAYTIME & COMFORTABLE FIT: Get up to 6 hours of listening on one charge and up to 48 hours with the charging case. The lightweight ergonomic in-ear design provides a secure, comfortable fit for workouts, commuting, work, and daily use.

    Product Description

    The T20 wireless earbuds combine smart control, immersive sound, and all-day convenience in one compact design. Use the built-in touchscreen charging case to adjust volume, switch tracks, answer calls, locate the ear buds, select listening modes, and control your phone camera without opening an app. Powerful 13mm drivers deliver Hi-Fi sound with deep bass, clear vocals, and crisp highs, while five EQ modes—Bass, Rock, Pop, Classical, and Jazz—let you customize your listening experience. ANC helps reduce distracting background noise, and ENC improves voice clarity during calls for work, commuting, travel, and everyday use. Bluetooth 5.4 provides fast pairing, low-latency audio, and a stable connection up to 33 ft. Enjoy up to 6 hours of listening on a single charge and up to 48 hours with the charging case. The lightweight ergonomic in-ear design offers a secure, comfortable fit for workouts, office use, travel, and extended daily wear, with support for iPhone, Android phones, tablets, and other Bluetooth-enabled devices.
